title: Buddy rebuild — try it in the test window

steps.path: In the window titled "YouCoded - Buddy rebuild": Settings, then turn the buddy on
steps.headline: Press the buddy: does the chat grow out of him quickly, and close just as quickly?
steps.changed: This test window runs the rebuilt buddy with its own settings, separate from your everyday app. The chat now opens without reloading the conversation each time.
steps.notice: It springs open from the side he is on (above or below him), in about a quarter of a second, with the conversation already there.
steps.risk: It is a second buddy on your desktop beside your everyday one; I will close the test window when you are done.

steps.path: Drag the buddy around with the chat open
steps.headline: Drag him around with the chat open: do the buddy, his chat and his buttons move together smoothly?
steps.changed: The buttons beside him are now one panel of four (screenshot, size, open YouCoded, hide).
steps.notice: No lag between the three, no jumps, and the chat never covers him.

steps.path: The second button in the panel beside him (two diagonal arrows)
steps.headline: Press the size button: does the chat get bigger, then smaller again, and stay the size you left it after closing and reopening?
steps.changed: Two sizes: 320 by 480 and 440 by 660. Point at the button to see its hint (Bigger chat / Smaller chat).
steps.notice: The chat and the buddy stay together and on screen; the size you left is the size it reopens at.

steps.path: Type in the buddy chat: "ask me a multiple-choice question with two parts"
steps.headline: When Claude asks a question, does it appear in the buddy at once, one question at a time, and does answering work?
steps.changed: New questions now reach the buddy as soon as they are asked (before, only after reopening it).
steps.notice: Small choices you tap, "+ Note" if you want to add something, Next, then Submit; Claude gets your answers.

steps.path: While a permission request or Claude's menu is showing, type a message and press Enter
steps.headline: Does the buddy refuse to type into Claude's menu and offer "Send anyway", like the main window?
steps.changed: Before, typing into the buddy at that moment could pick an option in Claude's menu by accident.
steps.notice: A small notice explains why it did not send, with Send anyway.

steps.path: Run something in a session and watch the dots and the buddy
steps.headline: Do the dots match the main window's, and does the buddy show it: a focused look while working, a wave when a reply is ready?
steps.changed: He follows the same colours as the dots: red or amber is today's surprised bounce, green is a focused look, blue (reply ready) is a short wave.
steps.notice: You can tell what is happening from the corner of your eye, and the dots never disagree with the main window.

steps.path: Leave everything quiet for a few minutes
steps.headline: Left alone, does he glance around or stretch now and then, doze off after about four minutes, and wake when anything happens?
steps.changed: Idle moments come every one to two minutes; he falls asleep after four quiet minutes and never does either while a session is busy or needs you.
steps.notice: Quieter than his "needs you" bounce; anything that changes a dot wakes him at once.
steps.risk: His breathing now moves in tiny steps to save battery; tell me if it looks jerky.

steps.path: Use the buddy chat for a minute: scroll, switch conversations, read a reply as it arrives
steps.headline: Overall, does the buddy chat feel as smooth and look as finished as the main window?
steps.changed: The chat is the main window's own chat, with the tighter spacing, summary row, short times and one-line permission requests you approved.
steps.notice: Scrolling back loads older messages; replies stream in without jumping; the All sessions menu works.
